title: Cross-Deployment Error-Budget Reconciler and Initiative Prioritization Engine
creator: Aisha Park
description:
Problem: We currently track error budgets and SLI burn independently per product area, but we lack an automated, cross-deployment reconciler that understands differences between Hosted API, Dedicated, and Private footprints. That causes (1) inconsistent throttling and rollout decisions across environments, (2) manual coordination when a shared incident eats into multiple initiative budgets, and (3) slow reprioritization of reliability work across teams.

Objective: Build an engine and console integration that (a) regularly reconciles error-budget consumption across deployment modes and model variants, (b) surfaces composite health signals and suggested initiative reprioritizations, and (c) can automatically trigger gating actions (e.g., throttle new feature rollouts, pause low-priority background work, or open an on-call war room) when cross-deployment thresholds are crossed.

Scope: Phase 1 focuses on read-only reconciliation and UI recommendations for PMs and SREs (no automatic rollbacks). Phase 2 will add automated policy enforcement hooks for Dedicated capacity and Hosted API routing policies. The feature will map SLI definitions per deployment, expose a reconciliation dashboard, and emit normalized burn rates and a suggested priority ranking for active initiatives that consume the same error budget pool.
acceptance_criteria: Reconciler computes normalized burn rate for each service and deployment type and stores daily snapshots for the last 90 days.
Console shows a cross-deployment dashboard that lists active initiatives, current burn, remaining budget, and a suggested reprioritization score.
Reconciler produces actionable recommendations (top-3 initiatives to pause or throttle) with justification and a confidence score in the UI.
Manual approval flow allows PM/SRE to apply recommendations; Phase 1 must not execute any automatic rollbacks.
End-to-end tests validate reconciler calculation against historical incidents (sample dataset) with <5% variance to expected burn rates.
Telemetry: events emitted for reconcile-run.start, reconcile-run.finish, recommendation.issued with tags for deployment, model, and initiative key.
Documentation (Confluence) and runbook for on-call covering how to interpret and act on recommendations are published before beta.
Stakeholders (SRE, Runtime, Console, PM) have signed off on the scoring heuristic.
Data retention and privacy review completed for Private deployment telemetry aggregation (paper trail recorded in links).
